name: Terrain Tile Serving Flow
description: WASM-served quantized-mesh terrain (mount /api/v1/terrain/, config-mounted on the sdn-server lane). A $HTQ HttpRequest enters on the http-request trigger; terrain-source:route strips the configured mount PREFIX (config key terrain_mount_path, default the basePath below; a path that does not start with it is a 404, so one tile is reachable at exactly one URL) and takes exactly one of three paths. "layer.json" => a layer_plan frame for terrain-source:layer_json, which renders the complete tilejson-2.1.0 body (format quantized-mesh-1.0, scheme tms, EPSG:4326, extensions [watermask], availability VERBATIM from the flow config key terrain_available - the availability index is the ingest orchestrator's knowledge and is configured, not aggregated per request at first light) inside the canonical $HTR envelope. "{z}/{x}/{y}.terrain" => a {sql,params} frame for hostcap/flatsql-query:query (SELECT _data FROM DTT WHERE TILESET_ID/LEVEL/X/Y ORDER BY rowid DESC LIMIT 1 - the newest stored record for the address wins) plus a context frame carrying the address and the client's If-None-Match; terrain-source:respond walks the returned aligned size-prefixed $DTT stream and serves the record's payload BYTES VERBATIM (they are gzip-compressed at encode time) with content-type and content-encoding FROM THE RECORD, cache-control public max-age=86400 and a strong ETag (record ETAG, else payload DIGEST, else a weak address+size tag); an If-None-Match match answers 304. An EMPTY stream is decided by the address's position in the published availability: OUTSIDE it a cheap CACHEABLE 404 (public, max-age=300), because a miss below the published pyramid is normal traffic and the client's own upsampling relies on layer.json availability; INSIDE it a SYNTHESIZED height-0 tile (200, public max-age=86400, strong digest ETag, header x-terrain-synthesized), whose water mask is uniform-water only at LEVEL >= the config key terrain_ocean_synth_min_level and uniform-LAND otherwise - fabricated water at a level nothing built paints continents as specular ocean. Any other path is a direct cacheable 404 from route; non-GET/HEAD answers 405. Bridge linkage: the only host crossings are the declared storage.flatsql_query_stream hostcall and plugin.getConfig.

triggers.description: One $HTQ HttpRequest envelope per invocation, pumped by the host at the flow ingress.

api.tagDescription: Quantized-mesh terrain tiles served from this node's $DTT record store (wasm; all routing, conditional-request and response shaping run inside the module). Anonymous by design: every response is cacheable and the record store is read-only from this flow.

routes.description: The complete tilejson-2.1.0 descriptor for the served quantized-mesh-1.0 tileset: scheme tms, projection EPSG:4326, bounds [-180,-90,180,90], minzoom 0, configured maxzoom, extensions ["watermask"], and the configured availability index verbatim (octvertexnormals is omitted until normals ship).

The stored quantized-mesh-1.0 tile at TMS address z/x/y (the path's third segment is "<y>.terrain") of the two-root GEOGRAPHIC_WGS84 pyramid (newest stored $DTT record for the address). The body is served VERBATIM from the record's payload: gzip content-encoding as stored, strong ETag, cache-control public max-age=86400. If-None-Match answers 304. An address the tileset never published answers a CACHEABLE 404 (public, max-age=300) - normal traffic, the client upsamples per layer.json availability. An address INSIDE the published availability that the store does not hold is SYNTHESIZED at height 0 rather than 404'd (200, x-terrain-synthesized: uniform-land, or uniform-water only at levels the builder actually built).

params.name: z
params.description: Zoom level, 0 at the pyramid root.

params.name: tile
params.description: Row + extension: "<y>.terrain", TMS row (0 at the south edge).

200.description: The tile bytes, gzip content-encoding, strong ETag.

304.description: Not modified (If-None-Match matched the tile ETag).

404.description: No tile stored at this address (cacheable; clients upsample per layer.json availability).
